# Mobile UI Router

Routing skill for Mobile UI Template tasks. Tells you which leaf to load (framework overview, design tokens catalog, or the runtime-mobile-widgets-js generated TypeScript interfaces).

**Canonical doc:** [`ui-frameworks/mobile-ui/SKILL.md`](../../../ui-frameworks/mobile-ui/SKILL.md)

The full routing table is in the canonical doc. Important: Mobile UI uses **widgets** (Ionic+React), not block patterns — don't carry over OutSystems UI assumptions.
